recognize_zh: 高倍下見彼此吻合的不規則血管腔，內襯細胞飽滿、呈立方或釘狀（hobnail），核卵圓、細胞質淡而部分空泡化，並有細胞脫落到腔內；內襯細胞溫和無明顯異型，符合 littoral cell angioma。
features: Irregular, anastomosing vascular channels containing red cells
Channels lined by tall, plump cuboidal to hobnail cells rather than flat endothelium
Lining cell nuclei ovoid with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; mild variation only
Pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm; some lining cells detached into lumens
Intervening stroma with lymphocytes and hemorrhage; no mitoses or necrosis evident
describe_en: Higher-power view of the splenic lesion shows irregular, anastomosing vascular channels lined by plump, tall cuboidal to hobnail cells with ovoid nuclei and pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Some lining cells are shed into the lumens alongside red cells. Nuclear atypia is mild, and mitoses and necrosis are not evident. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma; confirmation of the dual endothelial-histiocytic (CD31+/CD68+/CD21+, CD8-/CD34-) phenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma channels are lined by flat, attenuated endothelium without hobnail or shed histiocytoid cells.
Angiosarcoma has marked pleomorphism, frequent mitoses, solid growth and necrosis rather than bland plump lining cells.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis / reactive histiocytosis in red pulp
ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are scattered in otherwise normal cords and sinuses without forming a discrete lesion of anastomosing cystic channels.
